subject: Medford Square Rideshare Pilot Program
overview: The Traffic Commission approved a six-month pilot for a rideshare pickup zone on Clippership Drive and implemented significant lane re-striping and parking restrictions on Forest Street to manage rush hour congestion. The body also adopted a new policy to streamline the renewal of residential parking variances.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 10 meeting.

items.title: Medford Square Rideshare Pickup Area
items.summary: Approved a six-month pilot program for a dedicated rideshare pickup and drop-off zone on Clippership Drive, operating from 6:00 PM to 1:00 AM.

items.title: Fulton Street Crosswalk Daylighting
items.summary: Approved a 20-foot parking restriction south of the crosswalk on Fulton Street at Kellis Field to improve pedestrian visibility.

items.title: Valley Road Private Property Signage
items.summary: Referred a request for private property signage at 34 Valley Road to the Department of Public Works after determining the commission lacks jurisdiction over private way disputes.

items.title: Harvard Avenue Parking Restriction
items.summary: Tabled a request for no-parking signs at Harvard Avenue and Monument Street because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Ridgeway Road Speeding and Access
items.summary: Referred concerns about cut-through traffic on Ridgeway Road to the Police Department for enforcement and to the Department of Public Works for a consultation on the road's status as a private way.

items.title: Forest Street Rush Hour Parking Restrictions
items.summary: Approved no-parking restrictions on the west side of Forest Street during morning and evening rush hours to facilitate two travel lanes approaching Medford Square.

items.title: Forest Street Lane Formalization
items.summary: Approved formalizing a two-lane southbound structure at the intersection of Forest Street and Lawrence Road, including 99 feet of parking restrictions on the east side to align traffic flow.

items.title: Washington Street Parking Lot Management
items.summary: Discussed transforming the city-owned lot on Washington Street into a paid or permit-based facility to mitigate vehicle abandonment, referring the matter for public outreach.

items.title: Parking Variance Renewal Policy
items.summary: Approved a policy that makes residential parking variances permanent for current residents, eliminating the need for annual commission approval provided the permits are consistently exercised.
